newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia govt names Telstra sale brokers.
newsitem.headline: Australia govt names Telstra sale brokers.

text.p: Australia on Friday named the stockbrokers to manage the partial sale of state telecommunications giant Telstra Corp.
Finance Minister John Fahey named several firms as co-lead managers and co-managers of the one-third float in Australia, the Americas, the United Kingdom and Europe and the rest of the world.
"These appointments signifiy the completion of major appointments to the float team," Fahey said in a statement.

Merrill Lynch and County NatWest were named co-lead managers for the Australia tranche, Merrill Lynch and Salomon Brothers for the American tranche, Paribas and Cazenove for the U.K. and Europe, and HSBC James Capel for the rest of the world tranche.
Co-managers for the Australian tranch are BT Stockbroking, Prudential Bache and HSBC James Capel.
Co-managers for the American tranche are JP Morgan and Morgan Stanley.
NatWest Markets, West LB and Istituto Mobiliare Italiano were named co-managers for the U.K. and Europe and Nikko, ING Barings for the rest of the world.
The government plans to begin the sale of one-third of Telstra late this year. The partial privatisation is expected to raise at least A$8 billion.
Global co-ordinators for the float, previously announced, are ABN AMRO Rothschild, Credit Suisse First Boston and JB Were.
